source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-296–300 complete Volume 15 with secondary indicators and beneficial organisms, standardized sampling, context-sensitive action thresholds, biological-control compatibility, and pest records, mapping, and trend analysis. Evidence uses hemp-specific ant and aphid context plus current university greenhouse IPM, threshold, monitoring, and biological-control guidance. Public wording keeps organism role, monitoring signals, action decisions, beneficial compatibility, and regulated product authorization separate.
source.note: This batch completes controlled Volume 15 with ants/wasps/secondary indicators, sampling methods, thresholds, biological-control compatibility, and pest records/mapping/trend analysis.
